description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1887/37 of 05.11.2014, Rathmalana D/S DIvision - Cad. Map No. 521003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their identification numbers, locations, ownership details, identity card numbers, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land property matters, specifically title registration amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
